name: go-mapi
description: MAPI to Gmail bridge for Windows — a Wails (Go + WebView2) desktop app that routes legacy 'Send to Mail recipient' calls to Gmail as drafts

scripts.build: npm run build:interceptor && cd src/app && wails build -platform windows/amd64
scripts.test: npm run -w @marcfargas/go-mapi-app-frontend build && go test ./internal/mapi/... ./src/app/... && npm run -w @marcfargas/go-mapi-app-frontend test:run
scripts.check: npm run -w @marcfargas/go-mapi-app-frontend build && go vet ./internal/mapi/... ./src/app/... && npm run -w @marcfargas/go-mapi-app-frontend check

author: Marc Fargas <https://github.com/marcfargas>
